notes.title: Bug Fixing Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Friends,
In this update, we have fixed a number of issues, namely:
1. Inability to adjust the sound volume
2. Monotony of audio ambient tracks
3. A bug due to which it was impossible to move to the next game levels

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275183/9bdec1d1b032904647e3af8af8e11411880553b0.png[/img]
